dialogue_texts: Why have you returned, My Majesty? Also, who's this?
Hiroyuki Shirogane, head of the Shirogane Manor.
So some cool man just shows up and he's part of your group?
He's just taggin' along because my ordinary magic is too dazzling to resist!
Besides, this endless night is perfect for a little late-night investigation.
Focus, My Majesty. The spiritual pressure in this courtyard is highly unstable. The space itself is bending.
Hah! Think you can just waltz through my courtyard while the manor's in this state?
I don't care how flashy your magic is - nobody gets past without a thorough sweeping!
